opportunities.name: Kayak hotel search with guests and filters
opportunities.description: On Kayak Stays, search hotels for a {destination} from {check_in} to {check_out} with {rooms}/{adults}/{children (+ages)}, then apply optional filters (review score, hotel class, amenities, style) and sort the results (e.g. by price, low to high).
steps: Open Kayak and click Stays (Search for hotels)
Type the destination in the 'Enter a city, hotel, airport, address or landmark' box and pick the matching suggestion
Open the calendar and click the check-in date, then the check-out date
Open 'Rooms and guests' and use Increment/Decrement to set rooms, adults and children; set each child's age
Click Search (or Update on the results page)
Optionally apply filters: review score, hotel class stars, Free internet, Style, Amenities
Open the 'Sorted by' dropdown and choose the sort order (e.g. Price low to high)
parameters: filters (review score, hotel class, amenities, style)

instances.values: Le Marais, Paris; Mar 27–Apr 2; 2 rooms, 3 adults; sorted by Price (low to high)
Santa Fe, NM; Jun 16–Jun 18; 2 rooms, 3 adults
Kashi Vishwanath Temple, Varanasi; Jun 6–Jun 10; 2 rooms, 3 adults + 1 child aged 7; review 8+, 3 stars and up, Free internet, Family style, Air-conditioned; sorted by Price (low to high)
Los Angeles, CA; May 21–May 23; 1 room, 2 adults; filtered to 4–5 star hotels

opportunities.name: Qatar Airways flight search and fare selection
opportunities.description: On qatarairways.com, search one-way flights (regular or Qatar Stopover) from {origin} to {destination} on {date} for {adults/children/infants} in {cabin class}, then pick a fare for each leg.
steps: Open the Book widget (Flights or the Qatar Stopover tab)
Type the origin in 'From' and pick the airport suggestion
Type the destination in 'To' and pick the airport suggestion
Open the Depart date picker, choose the date and click Continue
Open 'Passengers / Class', set adults, children and infants, choose Economy or Premium (Business/First), then click Confirm
Click Show flights
For each leg, click the cabin price on the flight you want, then click 'Select fare' on the fare family you want

instances.values: Qatar Stopover, Colombo CMB → New York JFK; 24 Jun 2023; 2 adults + 1 child, infant removed; Premium (Business/First); Business Comfort fare on both legs
Flights, Doha DOH → Durban DUR (reached via Explore > Africa > Durban); 28 May 2023; 2 adults + 1 infant; Economy; Economy Comfort fare

opportunities.name: Qatar Airways hotel search (Booking.com partner)
opportunities.description: From Qatar Airways' Book > Hotels menu, search the Booking.com partner site for hotels in a {destination} from {check_in} to {check_out} for {guests/rooms}, then sort or filter the results and open a property.
steps: Click Book in the Qatar Airways header, then Hotels
Type the destination and pick the suggestion
Open the date picker, move to the right month, and click the check-in and check-out dates (or a '± days' option)
Click Search
Optionally change adults/children/rooms in the results sidebar and click Done
Apply a sort (e.g. Price lowest first) or filters (neighbourhood, Free WiFi, star rating)
Click See availability on a property, then Reserve

instances.values: Las Vegas, NV; Apr 10–Apr 16 2023; 2 adults, 1 room; sorted by Price (lowest first)
Washington, DC; Jun 5–Jun 6 2023; 4 adults, 2 rooms; Downtown DC, Free WiFi, 5 stars; St. Regis, Reserve
